title: `AVG` of integers is a `DOUBLE`, summed in double
verdict: `avg_int_result`: `DOUBLE`; the sum is a double, so 64-bit inputs lose digits
description: `avg` of any integer type returns `DOUBLE`, and its running sum is a `DOUBLE` too: `avg(9007199254740993, 9007199254740993)` is 9007199254740992.0, and `avg` of two `BIGINT` maxima is 9.223372036854776E18 without an overflow. No values give NULL.
reference: `avg` of `i64` returns `i64` in Substrait; the reference follows the declared output type (`avg_int_result`, #209). Spark's double result needs a cast back, which may be off where the sum passes 2⁵³; `sverify_spark.dialect` computes the average exactly from a `DECIMAL(38,0)` sum.

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_spark` runs each query four times on one local session: with `spark.sql.ansi.enabled` true and false, on the folded path (the optimizer evaluates a query over `VALUES` on the driver) and on the codegen path (`ConvertToLocalRelation` and `ConstantFolding` excluded, so the query runs as a job with whole-stage code generation). probes.json keeps one result per ANSI setting where the two paths agree. Spark 4.3.0 (pyspark 4.3.0), Java 21.0.12, Linux x86_64, `local[2]`, session time zone UTC, `spark.sql.timestampType=TIMESTAMP_NTZ`.

evidence.note: `AVG(a)` of an `INT` column with NULLs is 2.142857142857143, a `double`; NULLs skipped
`avg` of `INT` NULLs only is NULL, typed `double`
`avg` of `BIGINT` NULLs only is NULL, typed `double`
`try_avg` of the `BIGINT` maximum and 1 is 4.6116860184273879E18, a `double`, with no overflow under ANSI: the running sum is a double

provenance.notes: Spark's SQL query tests at tag v4.3.0: the golden files under results/ run with ANSI on, those under results/nonansi/ with it off.

notes: `python -m sverify_dev.spark_fuzz --rows 300 --seed 738`: random rows leaning on the fact's edges, each construct run with spark.sql.ansi.enabled on and off, on the folded and the codegen path, and compared with a model of this fact (value, result type, error class). 164 of 164 results as the fact says.
int_sums[2]: 300 rows, `avg(x)`, 164 of 164 results as the fact says.
Spark 4.3.0, Java 21.0.12.1, Linux amd64, local[2], session time zone UTC.
